propositions: The env-var registry generator recognises only os.environ.get, os.environ[...] subscript, and os.getenv forms; other accessor methods like pop and setdefault silently drop their keys from generated docs without warning.
A one-token refactor from os.environ.get to os.environ.pop reads the same variable but renders it invisible to the scanner, causing the variable to disappear from docs/env-vars.md with exit code 0.
The scanner's silent skip violates its stated invariant that new env-var reads cannot ship undocumented, because an unrecognised shape produces no diagnostic and the drift gate sees no diff.
The local lint gate does not catch stale or incomplete registry generation; only the full test suite catches it, teaching contributors to trust a signal that does not hold in CI.

The fix widens the key-bearing accessor set to include pop, setdefault, and __getitem__; makes any unrecognised os.environ attribute access raise an exception rather than skip silently; and adds a local --check to make lint to close the signal gap.
